newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Entertainment to open more stores.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Entertainment to open more stores.

text.p: Hollywood Entertainment Corp said Tuesday it plans to increase the number of new stores it plans to open to 250 in 1996 and 300 new stores in 1997.
Hollywood also said in a statement it plans 300 new stores in 1998. The company had previously said it planned to open 210 new stores in 1996 and 200 in 1997.

Hollywood Entertainment is a chain of over 400 corporate owned video superstores operating in 29 states. The company has grown from 25 superstores in 1993 to 117 in 1994, 305 in 1995 to over 400 today.
Shares of Hollywood were 1-1/16 lower at 20-1/4 in afternoon trading on Nasdaq.
